jobs.title: Brand Partnerships Manager
jobs.description: Bloom is a full-service workplace design consultancy, proudly supporting Poppy & Peonies in their search for a Brand Partnerships Manager to join their dynamic team. As Talent Advisors, we serve as the bridge between our Bloom Partner and you throughout the recruitment process. At Bloom, we don’t rely on automated tools to sift through applications—every resume is carefully reviewed by a real person to ensure a fair and consistent interview process. If selected, you’ll join Poppy & Peonies directly as a valued member of their team. We’re excited to consider your application! Please note that applications will be accepted throughout the holiday season. Thank you for your patience and interest in this opportunity! Hi, I’m Natalie Dusome, Founder and CEO of Poppy & Peonies. At Poppy & Peonies, we’re a fun and energetic brand that believes style and function should always go hand-in-hand. We’re passionate about creating practical pieces that make life a little easier and literally lighten the load. Building Poppy & Peonies has been an incredible adventure. It all started when my daughter Poppy was born, and I found that my accessories no longer fit my new life as a mom. I needed bags with pockets and organization that looked cool but also had functionality. When I couldn’t find them, I decided to create them myself. And so, in 2015, Poppy & Peonies was born. We’ve come a long way since then—from filling orders in my basement to appearing on Dragons’ Den, and now, expanding into new product categories and collaborating with exciting influencers and brands. It hasn’t always been smooth sailing, but thanks to our incredible community, we’ve never felt more loved and supported!We believe in our responsibility to care for the environment and are passionate about preserving the health and welfare of our planet and the animals that live on it. That’s why all of our bags are made from high-quality vegan leather, and our entire product line is vegan, cruelty-free, and PETA-approved. We ship our products plastic-free and use a combination of recycled, compostable, and biodegradable materials to mitigate shipping waste. We are constantly looking for new ways to make our products and supply chain more sustainable, reducing our carbon footprint. As our Brand Partnerships Manager, you will lead one of the most exciting growth channels for Poppy & Peonies. You will be responsible for building and scaling our affiliate ecosystem with a strong focus on brand partnerships in the U.S. market. This role sits at the intersection of performance marketing, creator partnerships, and brand collaborations, helping us expand our reach through authentic relationships with creators, UGC partners and aligned brands. You will own the affiliate strategy end-to-end from everything outside of TikTok Shop such as identifying high-potential creators, optimizing performance, building long-term partnerships, and scaling the program into a major growth engine for the brand. This role is ideal for someone who understands the evolving world of social commerce, thrives on building relationships, and loves turning creator and brand partnerships into measurable revenue. Does this sound like you? Are you excited about scaling affiliate programs and creator partnerships? Do you thrive in the fast-moving world of influencers and social commerce? Do you love turning great partnerships into measurable business growth? If you answered yes, yes, and yes—keep reading!

lists.content:
• Own the day-to-day relationship with our PR agencies, helping shape strategy, identify opportunities, and maximize media coverage.
  • Develop campaigns that generate excitement around product launches, founder stories, collaborations, and seasonal moments.
  • Build, grow, and manage our UGC creator program to ensure a consistent pipeline of authentic, high-performing content.
  • Lead and scale our affiliate program outside of TikTok Shop, building strong relationships with creators and partners who authentically love the brand.
  • Identify and execute brand collaborations that introduce Poppy & Peonies to new audiences.
  • Plan and execute pop-ups, launch events, community experiences, influencer events, and other brand activations from concept through execution.
  • Manage celebrity, stylist, and VIP gifting initiatives while building relationships that increase brand visibility.
  • Track the performance of PR, affiliate, creator, and partnership initiatives, using data to improve results continually.
  • Stay ahead of trends in fashion, media, creators, and partnerships to identify new opportunities for the brand.

lists.text: What You Bring to the Table:
lists.content:
• 3–5 years of experience in brand partnerships, influencer marketing, PR, experiential marketing, affiliate marketing, or a similar brand-building role.
  • Experience managing external agencies or cross-functional partners.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple initiatives simultaneously.
  • Excellent communication, relationship-building, and negotiation skills.
  • Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail.
  • A creative mindset paired with strong execution skills.
  • Passion for fashion, social media, community building, and creating memorable brand experiences.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment where you’re excited to roll up your sleeves and build.
    • Don’t sweat it if you don’t have everything listed above. We believe in growth and curiosity. If you have some of these qualities and are excited about this opportunity, then we want to hear from you!

We’re a fully remote team spread across North America, which means you can work from wherever you do your best thinking, problem-solving, and customer-obsessing. While this role is fully remote, there may be opportunities for domestic or international travel for team get-togethers, special events, and the occasional chance to connect in person.

lists.content:
Site Merchandising

  • Own homepage, category, and collection page curation to reflect brand narrative and seasonal campaigns
  • Manage product sequencing, sorting logic, and on-site search to maximize discoverability
  • Partner with creative and buying to plan promotional moments and content calendars
  • Drive cross-sell and upsell strategies through smart product pairings and editorial storytelling
  • Monitor sell-through data and adjust merchandising to support inventory goals

    • Conversion Rate Optimization

  • Own core funnel metrics: CVR, add-to-cart rate, checkout initiation, and checkout completion, and report on them regularly to leadership
  • Lead a continuous A/B and multivariate testing roadmap across key funnel touchpoints
  • Analyze session recordings, heatmaps, and funnel reports to identify friction and opportunity
  • Own checkout experience;  reduce cart abandonment through UX, copy, and trust signal improvements
  • Develop hypotheses grounded in quantitative data and qualitative customer insight
  • Report on experiment outcomes and translate learnings into permanent site improvements

    • Product Management

  • Define and maintain the ecommerce product roadmap in collaboration with stakeholders that align to business objectives
  • Write clear briefs and acceptance criteria for new features, integrations, and platform improvements
  • Act as the internal owner of the Shopify storefront;  triaging issues, coordinating fixes, and managing the app stack
  • Evaluate and manage third-party apps; own the relationship, renewals, and configuration
  • Keep the site performant and functional across devices, flagging and resolving issues proactively

    • UX Design

  • Lead UX strategy for all customer-facing digital surfaces
  • Commission and interpret customer research, usability testing, and journey mapping
  • Maintain a cohesive design system in partnership with the brand and creative teams
  • Champion accessibility and inclusive design across the entire digital experience
  • Translate business requirements into elegant, intuitive interactions that feel quintessentially Poppy & Peonies

    • Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Lead and mentor teams and external partners across ecommerce and web development
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional peers in marketing, creative, finance, and operations, acting as the connective tissue between the site and the rest of the business
  • Represent the ecommerce function in leadership conversations, bringing a clear point of view on priorities, tradeoffs, and what the team needs to succeed
  • Foster a culture of curiosity and experimentation, making it safe to test, learn, and share results openly even when outcomes aren't what you hoped
  • Be a generous thought partner to colleagues across the business,  helping others understand how the site works and why the customer experience matters

lists.text: What You Bring to the Table
lists.content:
• Proven experience leading ecommerce growth within a direct-to-consumer, retail, fashion, or lifestyle brand
  • Hands-on Shopify experience; you don't need to code, but you know your way around the platform
  • Proven track record of driving measurable conversion and revenue growth
  • Comfortable managing external developers or agencies with clear, concise briefs
  • Strong analytical skills; comfortable in GA4, Shopify Analytics, or similar
  • Experience with CRO tools
  • A strong visual eye; you can give design feedback and spot UX problems without a formal design background
  • A builder mentality; you're energized by a lean team and ownership, not slowed down by it
  • Genuine interest in fashion or lifestyle brands;  you understand how aesthetics drive purchase decisions
  • Clear communicator who can move fast, context-switch, and keep multiple threads moving at once

jobs.title: Fractional HR & Talent Advisor (Contract)
jobs.description: Hey, I’m Avery, Founder & CEO of Bloom. We’re a workplace consultancy that partners with founder-led, growing small to mid-sized companies who are bold enough to prioritize strong people systems, early. The companies we work with know that building inclusive, high-performing workplaces doesn’t happen by accident. They’re invested. They care. They just don’t need a full-time HR hire (yet). That’s where you come in. This is a contract role (2-3 days per week) where you’ll act as a fractional HR partner for one of our clients, co-building, crafting, and implementing people systems that create the foundation for thriving, high-performing cultures. You’ll get to do meaningful, strategic work while still being hands-on with the day-to-day. And you’ll have the support of our Bloom collective beside you. Who we are At Bloom, we’re not your typical HR consultancy. We work with founder-led, purpose-driven companies who’ve made the smart choice to prioritize their people early. Most of our clients are small to mid-sized businesses (think 10–150 employees) that know building an intentional, inclusive culture doesn’t just happen—it takes work. They care deeply about creating strong, scalable people systems that align with their values, but they don’t need a full-time HR hire just yet. What they need is an expert partner who can help them build it right the first time. That’s where we come in. We embed ourselves as fractional HR and DEI partners, providing leadership coaching, HR advisory, recruitment support, and the hands-on work of building policies, systems, and processes that are inclusive by design. Whether it’s making a client’s very first hire, designing progressive people policies, or guiding a founder through a tricky team challenge—we’re in it with them, doing the work that shapes high-performing, human-first workplaces. We don’t believe in band-aid solutions or corporate jargon. We believe in co-creating better workplaces with the people who are bold enough to build them differently. About The Role We're looking for a Sr. Talent & HR Advisor to join our team on a contract basis (2-3 days per week). This role is tied to a dynamic and ongoing client engagement, offering the opportunity to make a meaningful impact within a forward-thinking organization. This is a remote-first role open to candidates in Ontario, Canada, with occasional onsite client visits as needed. Are you an experienced HR professional passionate about shaping workplace culture and driving talent strategy? We'd love to hear from you!

Hey, I’m Avery, Founder & CEO of Bloom. We’re a workplace consultancy that partners with founder-led, growing small to mid-sized companies who are bold enough to prioritize strong people systems, early. The companies we work with know that building inclusive, high-performing workplaces doesn’t happen by accident. They’re invested. They care. They just don’t need a full-time HR hire (yet).
 
That’s where you come in.
 
This is a contract role (2-3 days per week) where you’ll act as a fractional HR partner for one of our clients, co-building, crafting, and implementing people systems that create the foundation for thriving, high-performing cultures. You’ll get to do meaningful, strategic work while still being hands-on with the day-to-day. And you’ll have the support of our Bloom collective beside you.
 
Who we are
 
At Bloom, we’re not your typical HR consultancy. We work with founder-led, purpose-driven companies who’ve made the smart choice to prioritize their people early. Most of our clients are small to mid-sized businesses (think 10–150 employees) that know building an intentional, inclusive culture doesn’t just happen—it takes work.
 
They care deeply about creating strong, scalable people systems that align with their values, but they don’t need a full-time HR hire just yet. What they need is an expert partner who can help them build it right the first time.
 
That’s where we come in.
 
We embed ourselves as fractional HR and DEI partners, providing leadership coaching, HR advisory, recruitment support, and the hands-on work of building policies, systems, and processes that are inclusive by design. Whether it’s making a client’s very first hire, designing progressive people policies, or guiding a founder through a tricky team challenge—we’re in it with them, doing the work that shapes high-performing, human-first workplaces. We don’t believe in band-aid solutions or corporate jargon. We believe in co-creating better workplaces with the people who are bold enough to build them differently.
 
About The Role
 
We're looking for a Sr. Talent & HR Advisor to join our team on a contract basis (2-3 days per week). This role is tied to a dynamic and ongoing client engagement, offering the opportunity to make a meaningful impact within a forward-thinking organization. This is a remote-first role open to candidates in Ontario, Canada, with occasional onsite client visits as needed.
 
Are you an experienced HR professional passionate about shaping workplace culture and driving talent strategy? We'd love to hear from you!

jobs.description: Bloom is a full-service workplace design consultancy, proudly supporting Poppy & Peonies in their search for a Logistics Coordinator to join their team. If selected, you’ll join Poppy & Peonies directly as a valued member of their team. We’re excited to consider your application! Please note that applications will be accepted throughout the holiday season. Thank you for your patience and interest in this opportunity! -------- Hi, I’m Natalie Dusome, Founder and CEO of Poppy & Peonies. At Poppy & Peonies, we’re a fun and energetic brand that believes style and function should always go hand-in-hand. We’re passionate about creating practical pieces that make life a little easier and literally lighten the load. Building Poppy & Peonies has been an incredible adventure. It all started when my daughter Poppy was born, and I found that my accessories no longer fit my new life as a mom. I needed bags with pockets and organization that looked cool but also had functionality. When I couldn’t find them, I decided to create them myself. And so, in 2015, Poppy & Peonies was born. We’ve come a long way since then—from filling orders in my basement to appearing on Dragons’ Den, and now, expanding into new product categories and collaborating with exciting influencers and brands. It hasn’t always been smooth sailing, but thanks to our incredible community, we’ve never felt more loved and supported! We believe in our responsibility to care for the environment and are passionate about preserving the health and welfare of our planet and the animals that live on it. That’s why all of our bags are made from high-quality vegan leather, and our entire product line is vegan, cruelty-free, and PETA-approved. We ship our products plastic-free and use a combination of recycled, compostable, and biodegradable materials to mitigate shipping waste. We are constantly looking for new ways to make our products and supply chain more sustainable, reducing our carbon footprint. As our Logistics Coordinator, you will support the smooth movement of product from our suppliers to our third-party logistics (3PL) warehouse and ultimately to our customers across Canada and the U.S. You will play a key role in coordinating shipments, maintaining accurate records, and supporting communication between internal teams, manufacturers, freight partners, and our 3PL provider. lists.content:
• Inbound logistics coordination: Support the coordination of inbound shipments from suppliers to our 3PL warehouse, including shipment documentation and scheduling.

  • 3PL support: Act as a day-to-day point of contact with our 3PL partner to support receiving, storage, order fulfillment, and inventory inquiries.

  • Shipment tracking: Monitor inbound and outbound shipments and proactively communicate updates or delays to internal teams.

  • Inventory accuracy: Assist in maintaining accurate inventory records between internal systems and 3PL platforms, including basic reconciliation support.

  • Documentation management: Prepare, organize, and maintain shipping documents, packing lists, and customs paperwork as needed.

  • Issue resolution support: Help troubleshoot shipping errors, damages, or fulfillment discrepancies in collaboration with internal teams and 3PL partners.

  • Operational coordination: Support warehouse scheduling, seasonal volume planning, and product launch readiness.

  • Cross-functional support: Work closely with Operations, Customer Experience, Marketing, and Finance teams to support daily logistics needs.

  • Process improvement: Identify small but meaningful opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy, and communication within logistics workflows.

lists.text: What You Bring to the Table:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Highly organized with strong time management and prioritization skills.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities.

  • Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets; experience with ERP, OMS, or 3PL systems is an asset.

  • A proactive mindset and willingness to learn.

  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a team.

  • Post-secondary education in Business, Supply Chain, Operations, or a related field is an asset.

• Lead assortment planning and category strategy across Poppy & Peonies’ product portfolio.

  • Partner closely with the Design and Creative team to shape product direction, ensuring concepts align with both brand vision and commercial performance.

lists.text: What You Bring to the Role
lists.content:
• You have 6+ years of experience in merchandising, buying, or product strategy within handbag industry
  • You have direct experience in handbag or accessories buying/merchandising, with a strong understanding of the category.

lists.content:
• Facilitate interactive sessions that build awareness, deepen understanding, and help participants lead and work with more thoughtfulness, responsibility, and care.
  • Use thoughtful facilitation techniques, tools, and activities to create learning experiences that are engaging, reflective, and immediately applicable.
  • Lead virtual and in-person workshops across topics related to leadership, workplace culture, employee experience, and anti-oppressive practice, tailoring delivery to each organization’s context and goals.
  • Help participants understand how behaviour, decision-making, and workplace dynamics are shaped by larger systems, structures, and lived experience.
  • Create respectful environments that support open dialogue, honest reflection, and constructive conversation around complex and sensitive topics.
  • Support leaders and teams in building the awareness, ownership, and practical skills needed to translate learning into everyday practice.
  • Help strengthen individual and collective capacity so teams are better equipped to navigate accountability, collaboration, and change.
  • Stay informed on emerging research and leading practices, and integrate those insights into facilitation approach, content, and materials.
    •  
    Did you know?  We know many strong candidates, especially women and people from historically marginalized communities, hesitate to apply unless they meet every qualification. Research has found that men often apply when they meet about 60% of the criteria, while women tend to apply only when they meet them all. If you do not meet every requirement listed below, we still encourage you to apply.

• You have a deep, intersectional understanding of diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) in the workplace and proven experience facilitating impactful training programs both virtually and in person.
  • You are excited about creating human-centred learning experiences that drive both collective and individual growth.
  • You value building trust and partnerships with interdisciplinary teams, external clients, and stakeholders.
  • You have a high emotional intelligence (EQ) and a facilitation style that is empathetic, compassionate, and resourceful—essential for navigating different personalities, viewpoints, and emotions.
  • You understand anti-oppressive strategies and decolonizing practices for organizations.
  • You have strong communication skills (visual, written, and verbal) and can present complex ideas in a clear, concise, and engaging way.
  • You are adept at using virtual collaboration tools and adapting facilitation methods to suit diverse client needs.
  • You are organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple projects and deadlines.
  • You can analyze feedback and refine facilitation methods to continuously improve learning experiences.

We’re especially excited to hear from facilitators with experience leading sessions on Indigenous relations at work, neurodiversity at work, and AI and ethics in the workplace. As Bloom continues to plant seeds with new programming, we’re looking to expand beyond the areas we already hold in-house and bring in facilitators with strong, demonstrated experience in these topics. Many of these conversations require nuance, care, and a real ability to connect big ideas to day-to-day workplace realities, and we’re looking for people who can do exactly that. If that sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.

• We’re a fully remote team and encourage people to work where they can do their best work. At the same time, because this role often involves facilitating sessions and meeting with clients, we ask that members of the Bloom collective work from a private, secure, and quiet space when doing Bloom-related work. This is important not only for creating a distraction-free environment, but also for protecting the privacy and confidentiality of our clients and partners.
  • This role is structured with flexibility in mind, and you will have autonomy in managing your schedule. That said, most of our clients operate Monday to Friday, between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM EST, and our training sessions are often scheduled within that window. As such, we’re looking for facilitators who can offer some availability during standard business hours.

Round 1: 30-minute video Zoom call with Shav (Director of DEI & Operations, Bloom)
Round 2: 30-minute interview with Avery (Founder and Managing, Bloom)
Round 3: 60-minute interview. You’ll be given Bloom’s content for a mini-session and will deliver a mock facilitation to a panel of our team members. There’s no independent work or original IP required, just an opportunity to showcase your facilitation skills. As this is purely a demonstration of delivery with no new content creation, we will not be compensating candidates for this step.
 

We are accepting applications for this role until June 29, 2026. All candidates who apply will be contacted with next steps in the interview process after the posting closes. Applications submitted after the deadline will not be considered.

This is a contract role on a project-by-project basis. If selected to join our collective of facilitators, you’ll be engaged as a contractor for a 1-year term, with opportunities to take on facilitation work as it arises. We already have potential sessions available for contractors as early as July 2026!

raw.salaryDescription: This is a flexible, ongoing contract role. Compensation is $40.00 to $50.00 per hour for prep work, routine administrative tasks, content development, and internal or client meetings, plus $500 per session facilitated. You will join Bloom through your corporation or as an independent contractor.
